findings.finding: The embedded receipt is pending_root_review, authorized=false, and provider_launch_authorized=false. The worker requires approved/true authorization before deferred mounted-input hashing. The receipt itself is a hash-bound local input, so approval requires rebuilding and re-reviewing a new packet; editing it inside r3 makes the input and bundle identities stale.
findings.consequence: The current r3 packet will fail closed before mounted-input hashing and cannot run the fit. This is expected ownership gating, not a source/recipe defect.
findings.resolution: Root reviews and owns any approval. If approved, build and review a new packet with the approved receipt; do not mutate r3 in place.

findings.finding: All 316 profile losses are checked finite, but the full-fit validator checks update counts, skips, GradStats counts/nonfinite norms, checkpoint tensors, and predictions without counting finite loss values across all 72,996 fit updates.
findings.consequence: A fit with a nonfinite scalar loss and finite gradients/artifacts would not be rejected solely for that loss. No V7 fit ran, so this is a contract-evidence limitation rather than an observed event.
findings.resolution: The current declared full-fit gate is exact updates plus finite GradStats and finite outputs. If root intends per-update finite loss as a requirement, add that evidence and gate before authorizing the fit.

findings.finding: Both arms use the same deterministic seed/epoch sampler and drop_last contract, but the worker does not persist sampled group indices or the identity of the omitted sequence; packet metadata explicitly says realized order equivalence is not independently verified.
findings.consequence: The source supports a shared deterministic order for the same selected group ordering, but the run receipt cannot independently demonstrate the actual dropped row.
findings.resolution: Retain this limitation in result interpretation. It is nonblocking for the declared paired sampler recipe.
